column1: # M1: the privileged commands of src_install use $(SUDO), which is empty for a writable prefix. First prediction: "user-github: installed ownership". The run showed a different mechanism: a literal sudo on the library install makes root create the nested prefix, the next command (run as the user) cannot create include in it, and make github exits non-zero, so "user-github: make -j2 github" fails before the ownership check is reached. M7 reaches the ownership check.
# M7: SUDO always set (the hard-coded sudo of the old github target): every install command runs as root, make github succeeds, and the installed files are root-owned in the user case.

# M2 new test: the first prediction was "unpatched direct build rejected"; the run showed that check passes (the unconfigured clone makes build exit 2 anyway) and "unpatched direct build diagnostic" is the assertion that fails.

# M3 to M6 target the vendor record writer in the form decided by EPICS-env (build-record and build-record.sha256 under cfg/<name>); the earlier two-file form had its own rows with the same ids M3 and M4.
